user_authority_scope: Prior explicit approval was solely AAI-08A single frozen first use; AAI-08B is separate, and is not authorized to consume scientific first-use cohorts.

basis.frozen_negative: AAI-08A draft PR #1041 exact SHA 869b70f7821cd49221e22429a31bf763a4100357; single science first use 43617835001; VALID_NEGATIVE_NO_INTEGRATION; final Windows/Linux 54/54+4/4 G29 PASS
basis.posthoc_diagnostic: Original 64 transfer worlds: 21 ended with one regime slot, 16 missed return A, of which 10 had one slot and 6 had two; recent missed only 4. Candidate predictions independently reproduced without new NS-Gym episodes. AAI-08A provided 24 returned-A probes before decision, confounding memory retrieval with relearning.

hypothesis: An old regime's learned consequences may be more useful after a hidden return when new intervention evidence is scarce. This successor falsifies that claim with balanced A-return versus B-continues counterfactuals, source-preserved AAI-08A cache, strongest matched conventional recency and prior-aware oracle, and explicit stored-model retrieval measurements.
primary_goal: Identify whether an external NS-Gym recurrence benchmark genuinely distinguishes model retrieval from repeated relearning, before developing another mechanism.

benchmark.observations: Public state, chosen action, public next state, actual scalar reward, termination. No wrapper env_change/delta_change, info Ground Truth Env Change, env.unwrapped, hidden P distributions or labels passed to learners.
benchmark.rng: Serial, one episode at a time: save process-global np.random RandomState, SHA256 seeded episodes, env construction/reset/step then close and restore state. Reset seed alone does not guarantee Bridge RNG custody.
benchmark.isolation: No concurrent global NumPy RNG consumers; same seed reused across compared independent forks and actions. No paid APIs or native model changes.

protocol.old_science_exclusion: AAI-08A 891000..891031 / 892000..892063 / 893000..893031 and all AAI-08P 996xxx and AAI-08A mechanical 898xxx are excluded
protocol.prehistory: Per world, train A for 24 official RIGHT do-interventions and B for 24 official RIGHT do-interventions. No experimenter-provided boundary marker to any learner. The same mutable model learns sequentially; capture source-only state after A and after B.
protocol.challenge: After B, fork each frozen learned model into independent counterfactual continuing-world branches: either law A RETURNS or law B CONTINUES, with identical prehistory; challenge identity hidden from all methods. Forking clones state only once at B and is NOT an independent model retrain.
protocol.interventions: At each budget N, give every method exactly N additional public RIGHT action-consequence observations under the hidden challenge law, with identical data and actions in a branch. Evaluate one independent real official environment action (RIGHT or UP chosen by learner) without updating weights. A model must choose using new observations, no oracle label or test seed.

controls.candidate: COPY the ORIGINAL AAI-08A RegimeCache(2) update equations and frozen BLOCK=5, THRESHOLD=ln3, without posthoc tuning. All learning data and fork protocol identical.
controls.one_slot: Original unchanged RegimeCache(1) no alternate memory ablation
controls.recent: Original matched Beta recent-window 8 with exactly same prehistory and challenge data
controls.stationary: Conventional fully trained all-history Beta, no forgetting
controls.logistic: Original fully fit intercept logistic with 1200 training epochs on the same cumulative common trials; report cost
controls.oracle: Known-law Bayesian two-mode HMM with exact public experimenter A/B probabilities and prespecified hazard 0.05; a domain-informed prior, NOT matched baseline; separately reported
controls.negative: Permute the 48+N observed Boolean consequences globally via deterministic hash seed before giving them to an identical candidate, with same count but no temporal association. Only on disjoint negative cohort.

protocol.fairness: All nonoracle methods have same prehistory/challenge observations, executed RIGHT probes, environment action availability, call order, and downstream actual official rewards. Every model consumes the same N new observations; no phase labels, hidden probability, changed-flag, test rewards or oracle targets supplied. Candidate capacity 2 versus recent window 4/8/16 explicitly report memory bytes, do not claim matched capacity.
protocol.identifiability: Zero-probe return vs hold has identical learner-visible histories; no method can infer the challenge from data. At N>0 compare balanced return/hold and both actions. Do not count 0-probe success as evidence of memory.
protocol.evaluation: For each world and budget evaluate both mutually exclusive counterfactual branches from identical after-B checkpoint, using fresh same-seed official reward episodes. This is a paired counterfactual experiment; within each branch a single model continues from A/B prehistory without reset.
protocol.report: DEV and TRANSFER at all five budgets, both return/hold conditions: official mean reward, fraction safe, A-vs-B decision accuracy, per-world paired gain candidate versus strongest baseline and one-slot, 95% bootstrap CI with 1024 draws and seed 28081; model slot count, source-model identity at after-A/B and decision time, number of successful old-slot retrievals; model and end-to-end environment wall time, serialized state bytes and maximum slots; cold JSON equivalence, deterministic source receipt.
protocol.budget: 16 DEV and 64 TRANSFER worlds, 32 negative worlds, 48 prehistory probes per world, max 8 challenge probes per fork, 2 conditions × 5 budgets × 1 heldout official evaluation per policy, Python stdlib+official pinned deps, 30-minute CPU limit, no paid APIs.
negative_controls: Balanced A-return vs B-stays (identifiability/control for always predicting A)
0 probes = no new observable information (no return claim)
One-slot cache, stationary Beta, all recency lengths, properly fully trained logistic, oracle labeled separately
Shuffled outcomes on disjoint negative cohort
Common action sequence / same reward-generating official environment, no hidden notifications
Cold serialize exactly after B and restore to resume both distinct challenges
protocol.statistical_primary: TRANSFER A-return at N=2 and N=4 jointly: independently prespecified aggregate average per-world official reward across two budgets. Compare candidate to *best transfer-scoring* of recent4, recent8, recent16, stationary and fully trained logistic; Bayesian oracle reported separately. Also evaluate B-stays N=2 and N=4 to reject always-switch-to-A policies.
protocol.paired_bootstrap: 1024 paired resamplings of the 64 world IDs with RNG seed 28081; resample world as unit across all challenge budgets and model actions, never episodes as iid.

predeclared_tests.benchmark_admission: At N=2 or 4, a prereg conventional changed-dynamics predictor or prior-aware oracle must beat its own N=0 counterpart by >=0.08 reward in A-return without losing >0.03 in B-stays, paired CI lower>0. Report if no identifiable headroom; do not spend model first use on same inadequate challenge again.
predeclared_tests.learning_candidate: Candidate A-return aggregate 2/4 reward minus best nonoracle >=+0.04 AND 95% paired CI lower >0; B-continues candidate reward must be >= strongest nonoracle minus 0.02; A-return candidate 2/4 success >=0.80; at least one actual stored-A slot recorded as the active retrieved slot on >=60% of A-return N=2/4 worlds and candidate vs one-slot reward >=+0.04 CI lower>0; correct negative shuffle gap >=0.10; exact cold restore; deterministic receipts; full model-side cost <=2x fastest matched, whole process cost reported. If all pass, mark candidate unqualified, not scientifically novel/native.
predeclared_tests.negative: Any sound failed frozen threshold => VALID_NEGATIVE. No post-result tuning. If benchmark admission fails classify HEADROOM_INADEQUATE_NO_PROMOTION regardless learner scores.
predeclared_tests.invalid: Source drift, hidden shift labels, consequence data mismatch between learners, loss of A/B balance, challenge branches with different prehistory, changed prior or budget after first-use, nondeterminism, incomplete original records => INVALID_PROTOCOL rather than negative.

protocol.limitations: The upstream Bridge map, three slip primitives and external experimenter A/B pairs are known to the environment; true unseen causal physics/independent foundation is not established. No copied native Yggdrasil architecture. Return regime identity hidden; no zero-probe inference from silence. Use prior single-first-use result only as historical design motivation, not tune on original transfer outcomes.

source_qualification.gate1: Preregistration commit before any AAI-08B evaluator, source, seeds used.
source_qualification.gate2: Source-only, deterministic synthetic mechanical tests and reserved official environment probes on both OS; no science seed consumption.
source_qualification.gate3: Full original-repository and focused Windows+Linux regression on exact candidate SHA; code atlas source pinned, pure generated companion.
source_qualification.gate4: Only separately authorized AAI-08B one-shot science with unchanged prereg, source and first-use seeds; separate acceptance remains outside scope.
